verdict.rationale: Omnirush is documented as a desktop GUI app for working with a coding agent. The only command-line mentions are launching that GUI with a `--password-store` flag and running the desktop app in dev mode via pnpm, which start the graphical app rather than letting you run the agent from the terminal. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI or terminal mode for the agent itself, so these are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal
